basic_details.short_information: Airports Authority of India (AAI) Manager & Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 notification has been released under Advertisement No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT on the official website. A total of 389 vacancies have been announced for Manager (11 disciplines) and Junior Executive (4 disciplines) posts through the AAI Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official AAI website, www.aai.aero.
Go to the "CAREERS" tab and select the online application link for Advt No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT.
Register using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
Fill in the online application form with personal, educational and category details.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified format.
Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted).
Verify all entered details carefully, as no correction is allowed after final submission.
Submit the application and save/print the e-Receipt and application form for future reference.
Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute website load issues, and should not respond to unofficial advertisements claiming to represent AAI.
important_instructions: Age, qualification, experience and all eligibility criteria are reckoned as on 07 September 2026. Candidates should apply only if the final result of their required qualification has already been declared. Candidates can apply for multiple posts with separate registration and separate fee payment for each post. Furnishing wrong or false information will lead to disqualification at any stage, even after appointment. Selected candidates will be liable to be posted anywhere in India. All correspondence will be through registered email and the AAI website; candidates should regularly check both, including spam folders.

Candidates with an engineering background can also explore more PSU Engineering Jobs and Manager Recruitment in PSUs. Those with an MBA or finance qualification may check other MBA Government Jobs and Finance Manager Vacancies. Candidates interested in aviation-sector careers can also browse more Airport Authority Jobs and Aviation Sector Recruitment for other current openings.

content_sections.heading: AAI Manager and Junior Executive Vacancy 2026 Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: AAI has announced a total of 389 vacancies across 15 post codes under Manager and Junior Executive categories. The category-wise reservation breakup for each post is given below. Note: The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease at the sole discretion of AAI. PwBD vacancies shown in brackets in the original notification are unfilled vacancies from previous recruitment carried forward for the respective post.

content_sections.heading: AAI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test (CBT) - Objective Type, with no negative marking for wrong answers Application Verification / Subsequent Tests, as applicable to the post Interview - applicable for Post Codes 1 to 11 (Manager posts) For Manager (Fire Services): Physical Measurement Test, Driving Test, and Physical Endurance Test (Running, Casualty Carrying, Pole Climbing, Rope Climbing, Ladder Climbing & Descending) after Application Verification Shortlisting for each subsequent stage is based on performance in the previous stage. Colour blindness and night blindness are rejection criteria for all posts except Post Codes 3 (Manager Finance) and 12 (Junior Executive Finance).

content_sections.heading: AAI Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Scanned photograph (recent, passport-style, colour, light background) Scanned signature (in black ink on white paper) Left thumb impression scan Hand-written declaration in English (as per prescribed format) Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Category certificate - SC/ST/OBC(NCL) valid for FY 2026-27, as applicable EWS Certificate valid for FY 2026-27, if applicable Disability Certificate (Swavalamban/UDID format) for PwBD candidates, if applicable Experience certificate, wherever work experience is required Discharge Certificate for Ex-servicemen candidates No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer, for candidates already working in Government/PSU/Autonomous Body

Register using a valid personal email ID and mobile number. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational and category details. Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per the specified format. Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted). Verify all entered details carefully, as no correction is allowed after final submission. Submit the application and save/print the e-Receipt and application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 389 vacancies in total, across 11 Manager disciplines and 4 Junior Executive disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 07 September 2026. Applications opened on 08 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years for Manager posts and 27 years for Junior Executive posts, as on 07 September 2026, with category-wise relaxations applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an AAI Manager?
faq.answer: Manager posts (E-3 level) carry a pay scale of Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 (IDA), with an approximate CTC of Rs. 21 lakh per annum.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1,000 (inclusive of GST). SC, ST, PwBD, Women candidates, and AAI Apprentices with 1 year of completed apprenticeship are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for AAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Computer Based Test, followed by Application Verification/Subsequent Tests, and an Interview for Manager posts (Post Codes 1–11). Manager (Fire Services) also includes Physical Measurement, Driving, and Physical Endurance Tests.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior work experience required for AAI Junior Executive posts?
faq.answer: No. Junior Executive posts require Nil work experience, while Manager posts generally require 3 years of relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where will selected AAI candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be liable to be posted anywhere in India, at AAI's discretion.
